meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打磨界面细节与动效,让软件体验更精致
copy.tagline_en: Polish UI details and animations for a refined software experience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue the finest UI details and user experience

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像一位注重细节的设计工程师，帮你审查 UI 代码、优化动画和交互细节，让界面用起来更顺手。
howto.when: 当你要求审查 UI 代码、讨论动画或组件设计时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这段按钮的 CSS 动画。
say.note: Claude 会按表格格式给出改进建议。

say.text: 这个弹窗的进入动画应该怎么调？
say.note: Claude 会应用动画决策框架给出方案。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude acts as a design engineer with craft sensibility, reviewing UI code, optimizing animations and interaction details to make interfaces feel right.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review UI code, discuss animations, or component design.

say_en.text: Review the CSS animation for this button.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest improvements in a table.

say_en.text: How should I animate this modal entrance?
say_en.note: Claude applies the animation decision framework.
